decisions.why: Preserve original compact attention-free learned quantile forecasting using computed periodicity and tied convolutional network; ~35x fewer parameters than selected Timestral-5M, separate low-resource research operating point. Not a quantization of incumbent; no evidence to replace multivariate/covariate forecasters.

decisions.reason: Separate 7.462M trained state; author GIFT-Eval 0.7003/0.4816, univariate; future covariates linear training-free ridge, tails extrapolated; no matched marginal benefit vs Timestral/Toto. Preserve source references, not formal registration.

Full Chronos-2 fine-tune on 3021 heat meters, 16000 steps TITAN RTX 9.3h; gain in Aalborg but overconfident aggregate intervals, little transfer to Flensburg/Helsinki, oracle weather, no independent evidence; public data and recipe partially reproducible. Keep base Chronos-2.
